# Sanskrit Grammar Sources

> Docusaurus index of digitized Sanskrit grammar sources (Apte, Bühler, Knauer, Kochergina, Zalizniak) plus the sangram declension-coverage toolkit.

## Grammar sources

- [Apte, A Practical Sanskrit Grammar with Exercises (1885) — unicode text](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritGrammar/grammars/ApteSyntax_1885/Apte-unicode/)
- [Bühler, Leitfaden für den Elementarcursus des Sanskrit (1923) — unicode text](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritGrammar/grammars/BuhlerLeitfaden_1923/Buhler_Unicode/)
- [Knauer, Фразы (sentences for translation, 1908)](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritGrammar/grammars/KnauerFrazy_1908/Frazy-Knauer-03.05.2023/)
- [Kochergina, Учебник санскрита (1998) — unicode text](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritGrammar/grammars/KocherginaUchebnik_1998/Kochergina_unicode/)
- [Zalizniak, Конспект-обзор санскритской грамматики (2004) — tables](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritGrammar/grammars/ZalizniakKonspekt_2004/zalizniak-konspekt-2015-11-X_bd_t/)
- [Zalizniak, Очерк грамматики ведийского языка (1978) — aligned text](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritGrammar/grammars/ZalizniakOcherk_1978/Zalizniak-Ocherk_29-11-20-aligned/)
- [sangram — grammar coverage toolkit](https://gasyoun.github.io/SanskritGrammar/grammars/sangram/)

Source: https://github.com/gasyoun/SanskritGrammar
